original_idea.body: # Deployment-vs-Test Belief Elicitation Probe. Two-channel harness eliciting the model's stated test-belief separately from task behavior; correlate elicited belief with misaligned-behavior rate. API-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Operationalizes the eval-awareness confound threatening all scheming evals; clear chain to eval validity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two-channel prompting + correlation analysis; accessible, API-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused belief-elicitation instrument; correlation across scenarios adds modest breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable instrument over open/API models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness elicitation studied; separating belief-channel from behavior plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Eval-awareness studied; separated belief-elicitation instrument plausibly open.
